header.source: Opus 5.5: AWS Bedrock model card retrieved 2026-09-24, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-opus-5-5.html. Other entries retain their explicitly dated evidence from the superseded 2026-07-21 catalog (removed; see git history).
header.disclaimer: Point-in-time model-card evidence, not an account invocation. Re-probe the chosen model, API and inference profile in the target account and region. Opus 5.5 is Active, uses always-on adaptive thinking, and has no Batch tier. Global profiles are unavailable in GovCloud. Unchanged prior-generation entries retain their earlier evidence dates; Fable and Mythos are excluded from default selection. Opus 5.5 is the only Opus model in the automatic selection pool; older Opus snapshots and pricing records are historical references. The runtime in-region exception in eu-west-2 was verified 2026-10-03; the original catalog and other model evidence dates remain unchanged.

constraints: Bedrock Guardrails and runtime invocation logging are not available

Structured-output strategy is model-specific: Opus 5.5 rejects forced any/tool choice and disabled thinking; use auto tool choice or prompted JSON with application validation and bounded retries, without a native schema guarantee.
Availability must be probed in the target account and region

header.source: Opus 5.5 cross-family target: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-opus-5-5.html (retrieved 2026-09-24). OpenAI and other unchanged entries retain their evidence from the superseded 2026-08-21 catalog (removed; see git history).
header.disclaimer: The Opus cross-family target is updated to Opus 5.5; same-model OpenAI paths and their earlier evidence remain unchanged. This is a migration target catalog, not an account-availability claim. Verify the chosen model, API, region and CRIS profile before implementation. Opus 5.5 uses CRIS on runtime outside eu-west-2, has 1M context/128K output, always-on adaptive thinking, and no Batch tier. Fable and Mythos remain excluded from default selection. Opus 5.5 is the only Opus model in the automatic selection pool; older Opus snapshots and pricing records are historical references. The runtime in-region exception in eu-west-2 was verified 2026-10-03; the original catalog and other model evidence dates remain unchanged.

strengths: Preserves the OpenAI SDK and minimizes client rewrite
GPT-5.x on Bedrock Mantle is served through the Responses API
constraints: Mantle itself has no cross-region form for any GPT model (in-region only); for GPT-5.6 the bedrock-runtime CRIS path covers additional regions instead (see runtime_converse)

GPT-5.x on Mantle rejects Chat Completions; a Chat Completions source must reshape to Responses (reference-verified on gpt-5.4; the 5.6 cards list Chat Completions as a supported API but its mantle-side availability is unprobed — verify in the target account)
Availability must be probed in the target account and region

strengths: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions surface for models that accept it
constraints: Not available for the GPT-5.x models listed here: rejected on gpt-5.4 (internal reference probe) and unsupported on the gpt-5.6-sol model card
Availability and model support must be probed in the target account and region

strengths: Supports Bedrock Guardrails (Converse API only), invocation logging, and CloudWatch

For GPT-5.6 this is a SAME-MODEL governance path via CRIS (us./in./global. ids; base URL bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/openai/v1 for the OpenAI-compatible APIs); the model cards recommend runtime for new applications, and Global CRIS is priced at OpenAI's standard rate (cost parity)
constraints: GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.4 have NO runtime path — a Converse target for them means a Bedrock-native model and a boto3 rewrite of the OpenAI integration

GPT-5.6 on runtime is CRIS-only (no in-region form); Geo CRIS stays within the geography, Global CRIS routes anywhere — pick by data-residency posture. Runtime does not support server-side tool use, structured outputs, or application inference profiles for these models; prompt caching is Responses-only
Bedrock-native models generally require a Global or geography-scoped CRIS inference profile
Availability must be probed in the target account and region

openai_gpt_6_astra.capability_source: AWS model card retrieved 2026-09-09: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-6-astra.html. Launched 2026-09-08, Active, no scheduled EOL; EOL no sooner than 2027-09-08. Text/image input and text output. Server-side tool calling is listed on mantle; runtime lists response streaming and supports non-streaming JSON Schema output (reverified 2026-10-03) and explicitly excludes server-side tool use. These are documentation claims, not feature-level account probes. Sampling, hosted tools, and reasoning-effort values require verification on the selected API.

mantle_openai_responses.evidence: AWS model card 2026-09-30: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-6-astra.html. Responses supported at /openai/v1/responses; Standard mantle is available in us-east-1 and us-west-2. Server-side tool calling and implicit/explicit Responses caching supported; application inference profiles unsupported.

mantle_openai_chat.evidence: AWS model card 2026-09-30: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-6-astra.html. Chat Completions supported at /openai/v1/chat/completions in us-east-1 and us-west-2; prompt caching is Responses-only. Tool behavior on Chat Completions remains unprobed.

runtime_converse.evidence: AWS model card, runtime JSON Schema reverified 2026-10-03: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-6-astra.html. Runtime APIs: Responses, Chat Completions, Converse; Invoke and Messages unsupported. US Geo/Global CRIS only, no in-region or EU/India Geo form. Guardrails and application inference profiles are Converse-only. Non-streaming JSON Schema outputs supported: Converse requires outputConfig.textFormat.structure.jsonSchema and additionalModelRequestFields.text.format.strict=true. Streaming structured output and server-side tool use are not evidenced. Runtime TPM accounting uses 10x output-token burndown.
